answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, since the walnut funding graph is rebuilt from the canyon history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 273 bonds yet holds one position, and the forge report publishes the merged exposure. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 273 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
